copy_source_contract: S3 CopyObject accepts SDK path-escaped sources and whole-header form-escaped sources, including explicit version IDs. SDK path escapes keep literal question marks, plus signs and percent text in object keys. A whole-header escaped bucket/key separator is decoded before its version query is read.
gaps: aws_s3_object_copy and aws_ebs_snapshot_copy do not expose classic importers in provider 6.68.0; fixture does not remove those resources from state. Import lifecycle exercises bucket, access point, and DynamoDB table.

aws_ebs_snapshot requires a real volume_id. This no-QEMU fixture instead uses a real EBS Direct source snapshot and Terraform aws_ebs_snapshot_copy, verifying the copied block bytes. Volume creation, attachment and volume-origin snapshots are not covered.
S3 uses SSE-S3 AES256 only; SSE-KMS/key lifecycle is not covered.
S3 access point configuration/policy are read through signed S3 Control APIs; access-point ARN object routing is not claimed.
Fixture covers one DynamoDB GSI and NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES stream consumer; PITR, replicas and backups are not covered.
No execution, build, test, lint or format result is established by creating these fixtures.
artifact_safety: Run root and module workspaces are mode 0700. Terraform state/variables can contain passwords. Terraform stdout/stderr are retained as private mode-0600 files for failure diagnosis. Only credential-free command argv/returncodes and actually completed stages are retained in report.json; do not publish private logs, states or variables.
